sources.name: GlobalSurnames — Los apellidos más comunes entre los panameños
sources.population: Panama; 2014 incidence rankings reproduced by the site; not an official current census
sources.method: Country-specific attestations, one attested form per diacritic-insensitive equivalent class. Where both accented and unaccented forms appear in the source, preserve its attested accented form; incidence ignored and no weights.
sources.license: Reuse/redistribution rights not independently established; requires review before production use
sources.note: Do not infer that missing written accents are deliberate national standard spellings; kept as explicitly published. Names are treated as attested surname tokens, not combined paternal/maternal pairs.

sources.name: Forebears — Panama surname distribution (cross-reference)
sources.method: Independent link for checking national attribution; NOT an additional ranked-weight source

sources.name: Panama-coded LocateFamily surname records, independently checked against Spanish surname dictionaries
sources.population: Country-labeled Panama public directory entries scraped by the source project in July 2019, not official surname registration or representative census
sources.method: Retain original 500 source-observed surname values unchanged, add 2,500 new Panama-directory surname candidates only where independently attested as surnames by Spanish name dictionaries. Exclude variants using accent/case/spacing folding, top 300 Spanish given names of each sex, obvious company/service words and invalid Latin names. No source frequency used in selection.
sources.license: GitHub repository declares MIT; source directory terms and Spanish name-data redistribution rights require separate commercial licensing review
sources.limitations: Secondary contact-directory surname-field data may contain historic residents, incompletely disambiguated surnames, migrants, or commercial records. Individual residency and licensing NOT independently verified; research-only.
